description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Compare 2-20 alternative plans on the same exact graph fingerprint side by side: intended edits, impact, contract and total blast radius, contract compatibility, policy errors and warnings, planned tests, reversibility, and uncertainty. Provide a version-1 alternatives input, saved FixMap JSON plan paths with the graphFingerprint they were planned against, or both. It never picks a winner or scores plans; it states each trade-off from the evidence. Read-only.

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

graphFingerprint.description: Graph state every report was planned against, such as the commit SHA; required with reports

input.description: Version-1 alternatives input object or path to a local JSON input file

reports.description: Paths to saved FixMap JSON plans, one alternative each

name: fixmap_alternatives
title: FixMap plan alternatives
